band_quantity: nominal face-on I_nu*cos(i), MJy/sr; use saved interpolation operands only
bin_endpoints: left closed/right open, last right closed; boundaries are existing Leroy knots, descriptive and not fitted phases
parent_authorization: root saved-data scalar audit; no producer/helper/operator/field replay
perfect_mirror_screen: Exact monotone mirror would require Spearman +1 or -1 and no opposing adjacent changes for that prechosen orientation. Both orientation counts reported, no sign/gain selection. Does not reject arbitrary nonlocal or retarded constitutive kernels.
physical_velocity_scope: historical Q1/legacy diagnostic readouts retained; full calculated-metric geodesic final velocity not supplied
residual_sign: model minus observed km/s; quoted observational one-error demand classes preserved separately
statistics: adjacent band-change versus residual-change sign counts; same/opposite/tie all reported
per-bin residual signs and inherited one-error demand counts
uncertainty: Only total SFR and stellar-surface RMS are quoted. Separate FUV/24micron RMS and cross-radius covariance absent; no p-values/confidence level or brightness-error claim.
